# telnyx_queues (Data Source)

Lists queues, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_queue`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `queues` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queues))

<a id="nestedatt--queues"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queues`

Read-Only:

- `average_wait_time_secs` (Number) The average time that the calls currently in the queue have spent waiting, given in seconds.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the queue was created
- `current_size` (Number) The number of calls currently in the queue
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the queue
- `max_size` (Number) The maximum number of calls allowed in the queue
- `name` (String) Name of the queue
- `record_type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the queue was last updated
